messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm doing a quick refresh of the quickstart that shows a Dockerized hello app + SDK v4 auth changes. Want to avoid the old inline API key example.

devon: SGTM. Can you drop the current `export REDWOOD_API_KEY` example? we should show the recommended pattern with an `.env` + runtime secret mount instead.

maya: Yup — plan is to show 2 options: local dev with `.env` and a note for production that uses KMS/HSM + env injection. Example snippet I'm adding for local:

maya: ```bash
# .env (do not commit)
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REDACTED
```

maya: And the SDK init example:

maya: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

devon: Nice. Also the Dockerfile in the current doc is a bit heavy. Can we switch to a small multi-stage build?

elen: I can share a tiny Dockerfile I use for the starter app — multistage, caches deps, exposes 8080. Will post in a sec.

elen: ```dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
ENV PORT=8080
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

doc-sam: For the docs site: please add a short note near the top about rotating keys and a link to the auth best-practices page. Also we should fix the broken anchor on the SDK config section — currently it links to `#sdk-config` but the header is `## SDK initialization`.

maya: Good call. I'll update the PR and add `#auth-best-practices` link. I also updated the code block language hints.

maya: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — includes Dockerfile swap, `.env` example, SDK snippet, and anchor fix.

buildbot: CI: docs/build — passed in 2m 12s on commit 9f2b4a1

devon: Quick nit — in the hello app README we reference `rw deploy` (internal). Can we change that to `redwoodctl deploy` or link to the public deploy docs? Some customers will get confused.

maya: Changed to `redwoodctl deploy` and added a short line about Dedicated vs Hosted. Also added a compatibility note: "If you use older SDK 3 tokens, see migration guide." Link points to /migrations/sdk3-to-4.

doc-sam: Awesome. Can you also squash the extra image asset and keep the screenshots under 500kb? docs site complains about large assets.

maya: Will optimize screenshots, squash commits, and request review from @elen and @devon. Targeting merge today EOD.

elen: I'll do a quick pass on wording after lunch.

devon: Thanks — ping me when it's ready and I'll sanity-check the auth flow copy. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team, posting final checklist in the PR description. :rocket:
